items.title: Yemen war makes reaching assistance too dangerous for many

items.title: Gaza: Families brace for fourth winter in tents as aid operations remain stymied

items.title: West Bank: Hebron crackdown displaces thousands, Türk warns of ethnic cleansing

items.desc: The UN said on Friday it was “extremely alarmed” by intensifying violence in the occupied West Bank, as Israel moved to seal off the territory following a deadly attack on its soldiers in Hebron.
